skill.name: claude-win11-speckit-update-skill
skill.description: Prompt-only guidance for planning Windows 11 system management and Speckit update tasks.
skill.summary: Guides Windows 11 system management workflows for AI assistants.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static URL findings are source repository references, not active network behavior. No evidence found of executable code, credential access, data exfiltration, or malicious instruction content.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL appears in frontmatter as a source repository reference. It does not instruct the assistant to make a network request or send user data.
The URL is a Markdown link to the source repository for additional information. It is documentation only and does not trigger network access.

content.value_statement: Windows 11 system management tasks can be hard to frame for AI assistants. This skill gives simple guidance for planning Speckit update work.
actual_capabilities: Frames Windows 11 system management requests for AI assistants.
Supports planning discussions about Speckit update tasks.
Identifies when to use the skill for Windows 11 management work.
Provides a source repository link for deeper project context.
Works as a prompt-only skill without scripts or bundled commands.
limitations: Does not include executable automation for Windows 11 changes.
Does not provide detailed remediation steps inside the skill file.
Requires the user to validate commands before applying system changes.
May need external documentation for specific Speckit behavior.

use_cases.title: Plan Update Work
use_cases.description: Prepare a clear task plan before changing Windows 11 Speckit settings.

use_cases.title: Review Management Requests
use_cases.description: Turn a broad Windows 11 management request into focused assistant prompts.

use_cases.title: Document System Tasks
use_cases.description: Create concise notes for Windows 11 maintenance and follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Describe The Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for help framing work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me describe a Windows 11 Speckit update task. Ask for missing details before suggesting next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a checklist for a Windows 11 system management task. Include validation, rollback, and documentation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Windows 11 Speckit update plan. Identify unclear assumptions, risky steps, and missing verification.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare An Operations Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to prepare an operations brief for Windows 11 Speckit maintenance. Include scope, risks, dependencies, and acceptance checks.

output_examples.input: Plan a Windows 11 Speckit update task for a shared workstation.
output_examples.output: A maintenance plan with prerequisites, backup checks, update steps, validation checks, and a short rollback section.

output_examples.input: Review this Windows 11 management request for missing details.
output_examples.output: A concise review that lists missing environment details, unclear success criteria, and questions to resolve before action.

output_examples.input: Document the result of a Speckit update discussion.
output_examples.output: A short operational note covering decisions, pending items, owner assignments, and next verification steps.

best_practices: State the Windows version, device role, and change goal before asking for guidance.
Request validation and rollback steps for any system management plan.
Review generated commands against trusted Windows documentation before use.
anti_patterns: Do not run generated system commands without understanding their effect.
Do not use the skill as a substitute for vendor documentation.
Do not omit rollback planning for Windows maintenance changes.

faq.question: Does this skill run Windows commands?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only skill and does not include scripts or automation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What is the main purpose?
faq.answer: It helps frame Windows 11 system management and Speckit update tasks for an AI assistant.

faq.question: Does it replace Windows documentation?
faq.answer: No. Use trusted Windows and Speckit documentation for exact command behavior.

faq.question: Is network access required?
faq.answer: No. The only URLs are source repository references in the documentation.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the device role, target change, constraints, and any required validation steps.
